clustering_methodology.stage_2: Graph Union-Find Superclustering on representatives (min-seq-id 0.3, cov 0.5)
clustering_methodology.scientific_rationale: Two-stage hierarchical clustering groups both direct homologs and connected family representatives into discrete superclusters, ensuring zero cluster-splitting and preventing homology leakage between training, validation, and testing sets.

leakage_verification.leakage_assessment: No identical or near-identical sequences cross partitions. Residual cross-partition alignments exhibit a maximum sequence identity of 36.2%, representing distant superfamily homology (e.g., distant beta-lactamase folds).
